capabilities: Act on the line under the cursor when nothing is selected
Skip tags, code fences, comment blocks, images, tables and blockquotes
Restore the selection and keep a single undo step per operation
extras: The manifest carries the note "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff", and the README says community-store installation works "Once it is approved"; pre-release use requires manual installation or BRAT. Documentation is provided in both English and Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in command to shift heading levels across a selection, forcing users to manually add or remove hash characters line by line.
summary: Heading-level editor that promotes or demotes ATX headings (h1–h6) on selected lines via hotkeys, the command palette, or the editor context menu.
